play.area.aspect_changed: Note: this changes the aspect ratio of the area.
play.area.at_min: The area width does not go below {min} mm.
play.area.capped: The area only grows as far as it fits on the tablet.
play.area.clamped: The move was trimmed so the area stays on the tablet.
play.area.no_room: There is no room on the tablet to move the area that way.
play.area.rotation_unverified: Rotation {rotation}°: this rotation is unverified, check that the move goes the expected way.
play.area.scale_mean: The aspect ratio is kept: the mean of both axes is used (×{fx} and ×{fy} → ×{f}).
play.area.shift: Area moved {dx} mm horizontally and {dy} mm vertically.
play.area.unknown: The area size is unknown; nothing is changed.
play.close.body: There are live changes that are not saved. Save them before closing? (No = go back to your previous settings)
play.close.title: Unsaved changes
play.conv.insufficient: Not enough data this round: play more of the same map.
play.conv.nothing_left: We see no more useful changes: it's a good time to stop and save.
play.conv.plateau: There is almost nothing left to gain: it's a good time to stop and save.
play.conv.start: First round: play and we'll see what to improve.
play.conv.worse: This round was worse; we'll try smaller steps.
play.find.good: We see no clear problems: your aim is going well.
play.find.jitter: The cursor shakes a little when you hold still
play.find.lag: On fast jumps the cursor arrives late (≈ {mm} mm)
play.find.reach_over: In the {dir} direction your cursor travels {pct} % more than needed
play.find.reach_short: In the {dir} direction your cursor travels {pct} % less than needed
play.find.timing: Your click timing varies quite a bit (this does not depend on the tablet)
play.find.untrusted: We couldn't match your clicks to the map. Check it is the right map and that osu! is borderless full screen.
play.map.orientation: Player's view: top = top of the screen
play.msg.filter_responsive: Make the cursor more responsive on fast jumps.
play.msg.filter_steady: Make the cursor steadier when you rest.
play.msg.live_only: It is live, but not saved.
play.msg.nothing_to_apply: There is no change to apply.
play.msg.nothing_to_undo: There is no change to undo.
play.msg.play_more: Not enough data: play more of the same map; nothing is changed.
play.msg.rejected: That change could not be applied safely.
play.msg.revert: The last try was worse: we go back to the best settings.
play.msg.scale: Adjust the area size to what you really travel.
play.msg.send_failed: OpenTabletDriver did not accept the change; the previous settings were kept.
play.msg.shift: Move the area so your pen reaches where it needs to.
play.observe.title: Watching your play
play.prep.keys_unreadable: This system cannot read the click keys (Windows only), so clicks cannot be judged.
play.prep.lazer: This looks like osu!lazer: the coach is built for osu!stable and may not line up well.
play.prep.map_not_found: I can't find that map in your Songs folder. Choose the .osu file by hand.
play.prep.no_map_title: osu! is not showing a map right now (you are in the menu). Enter a map or choose the .osu file.
play.prep.osu_closed: Open osu! and load a map.
play.prepare.honest: What the coach sees: where your cursor is and ONLY the click keys (Z, X and the mouse buttons). It does not read osu!'s memory: hits and misses are worked out by comparing your clicks with the map. Nothing leaves your PC.
play.prepare.intro: Play a map with osu! open and the coach will tell you, in plain words, where you miss and what to change on your tablet. It repeats until there is nothing left to gain.
play.prepare.map_missing: I don't know which map you'll play yet
play.prepare.map_unreadable: That .osu file could not be read.
play.prepare.minimap: Show a small map in a corner of the screen while I play
play.prepare.minimap_note: It is not visible in exclusive full screen; use borderless or windowed mode.
play.prepare.options_text:
Click keys that are watched: {keys}.
Only click times are stored.
play.progress.title: Progress
play.prop.revert: Go back to the settings of round {round}.
play.prop.shift: Move the area {dx} mm horizontally and {dy} mm vertically (in your view of the screen).
play.report.live_note: It is applied live in OpenTabletDriver, but NOT saved until you press "Save these settings".
play.report.title: What we saw
play.restore.confirm: Go back to the settings you started with and clear the round progress?
play.tech.alignment: Alignment: quality {quality} · {matched} matched clicks · speed ×{scale} · {flip} · offset {offset} ms · spread {spread} ms
play.tech.reach: Reach: gain x {gx}, y {gy} · bias x {bx} mm, y {by} mm · {n} points
play.title: Play Coach
play.warn.align_low: The clicks don't line up well with the map (quality {quality}); don't trust this report. Check the map, the speed (DT/HT) and that osu! uses borderless full screen.
play.warn.analysis_failed: This play could not be analyzed.
play.warn.few_matched: Only {n} matched clicks: play more for a solid report.
play.warn.not_enough: There are still too few clicks or data to judge the play.
